ios.desc:
You run multiple products. You shouldn't need multiple dashboards to check on them.

PocketHog pulls every PostHog project you manage into a single scrollable feed: visitors, signups, purchases, trend charts, and period-over-period deltas, all on one screen. Open your phone, see everything, move on with your day.

Sign in with PostHog in one tap. No API key needed for Cloud.


EVERY PROJECT, ONE FEED

Other PostHog tools show you one project at a time. PocketHog shows you all of them. Each project gets its own card with visitor counts, sparklines, and percentage changes. Scroll through your entire portfolio in seconds. Weekly or monthly view, your choice. Reorder and rename projects to match how you think about your business.


ADD CHARTS FOR THE EVENTS YOU CARE ABOUT

Each project card expands with extra chart tiles for any PostHog event: signups, purchases, tutorial completions, API calls, whatever you track. Every tile shows its own sparkline, count, and trend. Pair two events side-by-side to spot patterns across the metrics that matter to each product.


HOME SCREEN WIDGETS FOR EACH PROJECT

Small and medium iOS widgets, each tied to a different project. Pick which metric each widget displays. Glance at your home screen and know how three products are doing without opening anything.


ANNOTATIONS ACROSS YOUR PORTFOLIO

Mark launches, releases, and experiments directly on your charts. 


ONE TAP TO GO DEEPER

When a number catches your eye, jump straight from any project card to PostHog Max AI for full analysis. PocketHog is the quick read; PostHog is the deep dive.


WORKS WITH YOUR SETUP

One-tap OAuth for US Cloud and EU Cloud. Personal API key for self-hosted. Credentials stored in iOS Keychain. Filter out test accounts and internal traffic.


NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO PER-PROJECT PRICING, NO FEATURE GATES.

Built for founders, agencies, and teams who ship more than one thing and want to know how all of it is doing.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I have 5 PostHog projects and got tired of checking them one at a time

quotes.text:
If I'm reading the room correctly, a lot of people are about to have multiple PostHog projects for the first time.

Here's what nobody tells you: PostHog's web UI stores your project selection server-side. You can't open two projects in separate tabs without them fighting each other. To check five projects, you switch, wait, switch, wait, switch, wait.

I'd go weeks without checking stats on older apps because I'd rather be building than staring at dashboards. The problem wasn't that PostHog is bad (I love PostHog, especially the new AI interface) it's the checking is enough friction that I just... didn't.

I built PocketHog to put all of them on one screen. Every project shows visitors, trend direction, and a customizable conversion metric. Put a widget for each project on your home screen and you see the numbers without opening anything.

No SaaS monthly subscription, no auth, no back end, just your PostHog key on your device.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pockethog-product-analytics/id6759969606

Anyone else with multiple PostHog projects ... how do you keep track of them?
